title: Impl: Python OSCORE-by-default enforcement
description: After spec change (sibling bead), modify Python CoAP transport to require OSCORE context for all outgoing requests except discovery and EDHOC. Reject unprotected incoming CoAP requests with 4.01 Unauthorized unless on the exception list. File: python/src/lichen/crypto/oscore.py, python/src/lichen/coap/transport.py. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_oscore*.py tests/test_coap*.py -x
